record_title: Exact degree-two minimax and asymmetric extragradient on normal strongly monotone systems
scientific_context: For real normal affine operators with symmetric part at least mu I and spectral norm at most L, the exact real degree-two minimax polynomial on the strongly-monotone half-disk is 1-(1+mu/L)z+z^2 with factor 1-mu/L. An unequal-step extragradient cycle realizes this polynomial exactly. The best classical common-step extragradient cycle has the strictly larger exact factor (L^2+L mu+mu^2)/(L+mu)^2.
limitations: Affine real normal operators, Euclidean norm, exact arithmetic, known mu and L, and one stationary degree-two cycle only. Nonnormal transient growth, projections, nonlinear operators, adaptive or nonstationary methods, momentum, higher-degree methods, and long-horizon complexity are outside the claim. Older complex Chebyshev and semi-iterative literature leaves residual historical-equivalence uncertainty.

artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic boundary checks, real-normal sharp-witness checks, random tests of the two-point lower certificate, numerical minimization, and the common-step benchmark.
Verified output with software versions, deterministic seed, representative parameter values, error levels, and PASS status.
